title: The Prophets
description: A study of Israel's prophets - the Former Prophets' history and the Latter Prophets' oracles. Students learn the nature of prophecy, the historical settings of the eighth-century, Babylonian and Persian-era prophets, the major themes of covenant, judgment, repentance, justice, the Day of the LORD, the remnant, the Messiah and the new covenant, and how the New Testament proclaims their fulfilment in Christ. Special attention is given to Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Daniel and the Book of the Twelve.

quiz_bank.question: Describe three ways the New Testament presents prophecy as fulfilled in Christ.
quiz_bank.answer_key: Direct prediction (Micah 5:2 Bethlehem); typology (the exodus, David, the Passover as patterns); fuller/eschatological fulfilment of promises (the new covenant, the Spirit's outpouring, the servant) - often combining near historical and ultimate Christological reference.

quiz_bank.question: Give two principles for preaching the prophets today.
